title: set_options that sets the low threshold to its current value while it lowers medium and high: low stays 1
caps_note: No CAP applies: a classic operation that predates CAPs.
why: Inner transaction 0740c64a… of fee bump 7535dbce… removes a trustline, then a set_options moves the thresholds from 00010202 to 00010101: medium and high go from 2 to 1, the low threshold is set to 1 and was already 1. Two more set_options remove two signers. Only medium and high changed; a reader that writes one row per threshold named in the operation body records a low-threshold change that did not happen.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger with 232 transactions at Protocol 29; this entry's pattern is transaction 124 in apply order, a fee bump. Written by stellar-core 30.0.0 at the same protocol era, so it is not marked regenerated.

values.note: After: master 0, low 1, medium 1, high 1. The low threshold did not change.

notes: Input of finding F-0072 (SIGNATURE_THRESHOLD UPDATE). Expected: one thresholds_changed whose values after are master 0, low 1, medium 1, high 1; the low threshold before and after is 1 (pinned). The neutral thresholds_changed carries values after only, so the replay matcher cannot tell a row for the unchanged low threshold from a row for the changed ones.
